english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for intense hatred or strong dislike.
Use this for hatred in general when the wording is more formal or written than 仇恨.

examples.english: Wars often leave behind deep hatred.
examples.traditional: 戰爭往往會留下深重嘅憎恨。
